edges.projection: scale * [left, top, left + width, top + height]
edges.report: every signed edge residual, maximum absolute residual, node, operation, scale, backend, comparison stage

masks: Compare logical viewport independently of snapped host bounds; no occlusion or input-dispatch parity claim.
failure_policy: Every strict failure remains failed, including source-explained Double/f32 differences. No post-result tolerance adjustment, integer-only comparison, or aggregate-only acceptance.
control_policy: Production-path source mutations must compile and execute. Each requires an independently predicted semantic witness and additional violation beyond baseline. Compilation failure is not a killed control.
qualification: Bounded source-derived NoopTextSystem text/layout pairing, not native-font, screenshot, full-popover, or general constraint-dependent measurement parity.
